 BLITZ on 6: Week 11 
 High School Football Highlights 
 (KAUZ) By Spencer R. Smith Published : Nov. 6, 2026 at 10:45 PM CST Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google WICHITA FALLS, Texas (KAUZ) - Week 11 of high school football is here and marks a pivotal point in many teams’ seasons, including the Crosstown Showdown between Wichita Falls Legacy Leopards and the Wichita Falls Memorial Mavericks.
 A look at the final scores can be found here . 
 Check out our highlights from this week below:
 Game of the Week: Crosstown Showdown 
 Wichita Falls Memorial @ Wichita Falls Legacy (55 - 17)
 Breckenridge @ Henrietta (64-35)
 Peaster @ Vernon (10-7)
 Perrin-Whitt @ Northside (54-8)
 Electra @ Archer City (60-0)
 Munday @ Windthorst (55-6)
 Haskell @ Seymour (60-27)
